## Overview

Add opt-in A8W4 Kimi-K3 MegaMoE backends on eight gfx950 GPUs: MegaMoEV2 expert parallelism, plus the earlier MegaMoeTP path. Both support the bounded graph+DSpark recipe. Default backend behavior stays unchanged. This draft records performance regressions and does not claim a speedup.

## MegaMoEV2 EP

Enable with `--tensor-parallel-size 8 --enable-expert-parallel --moe-backend aiter_mega_moe --all2all-backend mori_high_throughput --additional-config '{"k3_megamoe_tp":"off"}'`. Set `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_SITUV2=a8w4`, `MORI_SHMEM_HEAP_SIZE=8G`, `MORI_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo`, MRV2, Gluon MLA and disabled shared-expert stream. The rendered model recipe is linked from the supported-model index.

TP8 attention + EP8 routed experts + DP1 gives112 complete experts per GPU. Route the global batch before token partitioning to preserve graph padding masks, run V2 dispatch/compute/combine on each rank's slice, then gather latent rows before the original RMSNorm/up-projection. Keep the original shared MLP precision and reduce it separately; no shared requantization/fusion or duplicate routed reduction. Reuse the existing DSv4 expert loader/packing/runtime-cache implementation without changing that model's source. The K3 runtime sets SiTUv2 beta4/linear-beta25 and A8W4 explicitly.

The locked AITER path uses FlyDSL intra-node dispatch/combine with MoRI SHMEM peer pointers, not MORI-IO transfer APIs. TCP bootstrap is control initialization; the eight-GPU node topology is one-hop XGMI. Hardware traffic counters were not profiled. DP8/TP1 + the real draft exceeds the usable memory budget before MoRI/KV; it was rejected by weight accounting, not reported as an observed OOM.

Guarded scope: gfx950/BF16 model tensors/exact K3 latent shape, TP8/EP8/DP1/PP1, MRV2, <=4K context/C32/batched tokens1024, auto KV dtype, exactly8GiB KV/GPU, no prefix caching. Graph requires no Inductor, FULL_DECODE_ONLY, capture sizes `[4,8,16,32,64,128]` and actual Gluon metadata. K3 DSpark uses TP8/three draft tokens/TRITON_MLA. Reject EPLB/DBO/ubatching/CP/SP/LoRA/specialized decode and simultaneous TP Mega. Weight reload remains unsupported.

## Matched EP validation

| TP8 attention / EP8 experts, graph + DSpark, A8W4 | GSM8K correct | Truncations | Median seconds |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Native EP (`aiter`) | 1247/1319 | 0 | 1.905887 |
| MegaMoEV2 (`aiter_mega_moe`) | 1251/1319 | 0 | 2.425798 |

Both arms use actual LLM constructors and real Worker.load_model, identical graph/draft/cache/scheduler configuration and explicit A8W4. Native selection was92 Mxfp4MoEMethod modules/112 local experts; V2 was92 modules/one runtime. Every rank had actual FULL replay and both arms had positive DSpark accepted/drafted counts.

GSM8K: all1319 questions, first five train shots, greedy/seed1234/max512/batch32. V2 changes accuracy by +0.303pp; lost/gained=17/21. Original max1pp drop gate passes; no per-question/logits/statistical equivalence claim. Timing is only ISL256/OSL64/C8, warmup1/trials3: V2 is 27.3% slower (0.786x). Untuned; no causal profile or broad performance claim.

Default-worker actual V2 API in ordinary runtime mode also passed real completion/positive draft-counter deltas, finite generated logprobs, ten token/context boundaries including4095+1 success/4097 rejection, and a nonempty chat smoke. A separate VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error attempt failed at per_req_len.min().item() in unchanged base Gluon MLA metadata, before model forward; that sync remains unfixed and strict validation has not passed. No strict native-off comparison was run. The final candidate adds typing/docstrings and stricter draft/target attention guards; runtime ASTs of four numerical modules match the full-quality source after excluding configuration validation and typing/docstrings. The attention rejection probe failed before the guard change and passed afterward. Layer66 eager/changed-input graph checks passed the original independent FP32 EP threshold0.10 (observed max relL2 .007812875); operator checks are separate from model evals.

## Earlier TP path and limits

Keep the prior `k3_megamoe_tp=mega` implementation and its TP8/noEP guards. Its separate matched graph+DSpark run scored native1255/Mega1261 of1319, no truncation, and1.643770/2.385155s at the same timing workload (Mega45.1% slower). Those results are not V2 results. Earlier TP teacher-prefill logprobs were unequal (max .3423) and independent latent differences reached .0197; unresolved, not claims about this new EP comparison.

8MI355X; target96shard K3; PyTorch2.13.0+git733fca1/HIP7.2.53211; AITER313f86a7 with task-local core/sorting rebuild. Seven image-native libraries are reused with Python base390836a/image metadata81198e97. Fresh native build and full-checkpoint CI coverage remain unverified. Shutdown shared-memory and missing-version warnings remain in the raw logs. Padded ASM failed earlier whole-model quality; bounded Gluon avoids that route rather than fixing ASM. No BF16/monokernel/SA branch changes and no tuning JSON promoted.

Validation commands used `torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 k3_ep_layer_gate_1023.py`, `python k3_ep_model_graph_dspark_1023.py --mode mega|off --output ...` (each arm separately, with the recipe environment), and default `vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server` with the documented flags. Full harnesses/configs/predictions/inventories/failures are retained in workspace evidence; derived comparisons are labeled separately. They are not public CI results or uploaded raw artifacts. All16 applicable precommit checks, including mypy, pass; the unfiltered runner previously stalled installing an inapplicable actionlint Go environment.

Related work checked: #53556 NVIDIA K3 BF16 shared tail, #63039 MiMo TP MegaMoE, #63040 DSv4 TP MegaMoE. This is the distinct AMD K3 A8W4 latent-loader/backend integration; no separate duplicate PR. No issue was supplied. Current PR has no human reviews/inline concerns at the latest read-only snapshot.

AI assistance was used. The human author requested this draft; every changed line and the reported validation still require human review before readiness/merge. Keep draft status. Remaining work includes tuning/performance regression analysis, wider configurations, ASM diagnosis, weight reload and CI coverage.

@@ -0,0 +1,214 @@
+# Experimental Kimi-K3 MegaMoE on ROCm
+
+The TP path below targets Kimi-K3 MXFP4 routed experts on eight gfx950 GPUs.
+It uses FP8 activations, SiTUv2 (beta 4, linear beta 25), and the existing router.
+It requires an AITER build with MegaMoeTP and explicit FP8 SiTUv2 fused-MoE support.
+For the separate EP backend, see [MegaMoEV2](#megamoev2-expert-parallelism).
+The default is `off`.
+
+Select eager execution with
+`--enforce-eager --additional-config '{"k3_megamoe_tp":"mega"}'`.
+`split` selects the same A8W4 split-MoE implementation used for large prefill,
+for a precision-matched eager comparison. The default MXFP4 backend may use a
+different activation precision. Select
+`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_SITUV2=a8w4` explicitly for a native A8W4
+comparison with `off`; the default `auto` selects A4W4 and synchronizes
+AITER's activation environment during import.
+
+Supported deployment: TP8, PP1, DP1, BF16 model tensors, no EP, context/sequence
+parallelism, ubatching, DBO, LoRA, or specialized decode. Unsupported configurations
+raise before expert execution. Shared experts execute serially on the main stream;
+the persistent kernel must have exclusive GPU use.
+
+The model owns one communication runtime shared across its MoE layers. Weight
+loading converts the original separated MXFP4 checkpoint bytes once and releases
+the original raw storage. MegaMoE stores standard separated packing; split mode
+stores the FP8 split kernels' interleaved packing. Global token counts up to 256
+use MegaMoE, padded to a multiple of eight. Larger counts temporarily unpack and
+repack the same quantized bytes for split A8W4 plus TP all-reduce. This conversion
+adds prefill work and transient memory, without retaining both formats per layer.
+A reduced latent output is normalized without another reduction; its
+up-projection shard is merged with the shared partial before the final reduction.
+
+## Decode graphs
+
+Graph support is restricted to MegaMoE with Model Runner V2, no Inductor,
+`FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, a 4096-token maximum context, at most 32 requests and 1024
+batched tokens, prefix caching disabled, auto KV dtype, and an explicit 8 GiB KV
+cache budget per GPU. Set `VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MLA_ASM_PADDING=gluon`.
+The actual target MLA metadata must select Gluon decode or verify; a backend or
+cache-size fallback raises before capture/execution. A requested environment
+setting alone does not establish the actual kernel route.
+
+For example, add these settings to the normal Kimi-K3 TP8 launch:
+
+```bash
+export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
+export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_SITUV2=a8w4
+export VLLM_DISABLE_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM=1
+export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1
+export VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MLA_ASM_PADDING=gluon
+# Omit --enforce-eager for graph execution.
+vllm serve moonshotai/Kimi-K3 \
+    --tensor-parallel-size 8 --language-model-only \
+    --dtype bfloat16 --max-model-len 4096 \
+    --max-num-seqs 32 --max-num-batched-tokens 1024 \
+    --kv-cache-memory-bytes 8589934592 --no-enable-prefix-caching \
+    --disable-custom-all-reduce \
+    --additional-config '{"k3_megamoe_tp":"mega"}' \
+    --compilation-config '{"mode":0,"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[1,2,4,8,16,32]}'
+```
+
+Padded ASM and default compilation failed whole-model quality checks in the tested
+environment. This limited Gluon configuration avoids that failing route; it does
+not fix the ASM kernel or establish support for other graph configurations.
+Split mode remains eager only. Isolated operator graph tests do not establish
+whole-model graph correctness.
+
+## DSpark
+
+The supported speculative configuration is the K3 DSpark model on TP8, three
+draft tokens, and `TRITON_MLA` draft attention. Reuse the existing K3 DSpark
+implementation; the target routed experts continue to use A8W4 MegaMoE.
+Other speculative methods are rejected. The context, batching, KV budget and
+prefix-caching restrictions above also apply to eager DSpark.
+
+For graph + DSpark, replace the graph capture sizes above with
+`[4,8,16,32,64,128]` and add:
+
+```bash
+--speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","model":"Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"TRITON_MLA"}'
+```
+
+Capture sizes count global target verification tokens, including the bonus
+token: 32 requests with three draft tokens require a capacity of 128. They are
+not per-rank EP batch sizes. Larger capture capacities are rejected; the temporary
+TP-to-split packing path cannot run during graph capture.
+
+## MegaMoEV2 expert parallelism
+
+The separate `aiter_mega_moe` backend uses AITER MegaMoEV2 with TP8 attention,
+EP8 routed experts and DP1. Each GPU owns 112 complete experts. It requires
+an AITER build supporting SiTUv2 A8W4 MegaMoEV2 and MoRI SHMEM.
+The TP-specific `k3_megamoe_tp` option must remain `off`.
+
+The router selects experts on the replicated global token batch before tokens
+are padded and divided across TP ranks. MegaMoEV2 dispatches each rank's token
+slice to the expert owners and combines the latent results. A TP all-gather
+reconstructs the global latent batch before the original RMSNorm/up projection.
+The original shared MLP retains its precision and a separate TP reduction.
+No shared-expert requantization or fusion is performed. EP tokens per rank
+are distinct from the global token count used by MegaMoeTP.
+
+The current AITER implementation uses its intra-node FlyDSL dispatch/combine
+kernel with MoRI symmetric-memory allocations and peer pointers. It does not
+call MORI-IO transfer APIs. TCP bootstrap initializes the SHMEM environment;
+it does not imply TCP token transfer. On a single node, `MORI_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo`
+avoids selecting an unreachable bootstrap interface. P2P data is intended to
+use the node's GPU interconnect; hardware link counters have not been profiled.
+
+For the same bounded graph and DSpark settings documented above, replace
+the TP-specific backend selection with:
+
+```bash
+export MORI_SHMEM_HEAP_SIZE=8G
+export MORI_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo
+# Keep AITER, A8W4, MRV2, Gluon and shared-stream settings above.
+# Add these arguments to the bounded graph + DSpark launch:
+--enable-expert-parallel --moe-backend aiter_mega_moe \
+    --all2all-backend mori_high_throughput \
+    --additional-config '{"k3_megamoe_tp":"off"}'
+```
+
+Only TP8/EP8/DP1/PP1 on gfx950 with the exact K3 latent/SiTUv2 shape is
+supported. The same 4K context, C32, batched-token1024, 8GiB KV, MRV2,
+Gluon FULL_DECODE_ONLY and TP8 DSpark3 restrictions apply. Prefix caching,
+EPLB, DBO, ubatching, sequence/context parallelism, LoRA and specialized decode
+are rejected. Eight GPUs must be available exclusively to the persistent kernel.
+DP8/TP1 with this checkpoint and draft does not leave enough memory for the
+MoRI heap and KV cache in the tested memory budget.
+
+### V2 validation
+
+A real-checkpoint layer passed all 66 eager/changed-input graph checks for
+global token counts 1/7/8/9/32/128 against the existing FP32 EP reference
+threshold (relative L2 <=0.10); the observed maximum was 0.007812875.
+This operator threshold is separate from whole-model quality.
+
+Both full-model arms used TP8 attention, EP8 experts, DP1, explicit A8W4,
+FULL_DECODE_ONLY, the same K3 DSpark draft and the bounded recipe above.
+The native arm had 92 Mxfp4MoEMethod modules and 112 experts per rank; V2 had
+92 MegaMoEV2 expert modules and one shared runtime per rank. Every rank
+recorded actual FULL replay, and both arms recorded nonzero DSpark acceptance.
+
+| TP8 attention / EP8 experts, graph + DSpark, A8W4 | GSM8K correct | Truncations | Median seconds |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| Native EP (`aiter`) | 1247/1319 | 0 | 1.905887 |
+| MegaMoEV2 (`aiter_mega_moe`) | 1251/1319 | 0 | 2.425798 |
+
+Quality used all 1319 GSM8K test questions, the first five train examples as
+shots, greedy sampling, seed1234, max512 output tokens and batches of32.
+V2 changed accuracy by +0.303 percentage points,
+with 17 questions lost and 21 gained.
+The preselected maximum1pp drop gate passed; this is not statistical,
+per-question or logits equivalence.
+
+Timing used only ISL256/OSL64/concurrency8, one warmup and three trials.
+These offline end-to-end medians give 0.786x native/V2 speedup:
+V2 took 27.3% longer. No tuning or profiler attribution was performed,
+and three trials do not establish stable or general performance.
+
+The actual default-worker V2 graph+DSpark API additionally passed four
+completions with positive accepted/drafted counter deltas, finite generated
+logprobs, token-count boundaries1/7/8/9/255/256/257/1024, 4095+1 success,
+4097 HTTP400 rejection and a nonempty chat smoke in ordinary runtime mode.
+A separate VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error attempt failed in unchanged base Gluon
+MLA metadata at per_req_len.min().item(), before model forward. Strict sync
+validation has not passed and that synchronization remains unfixed.
+Full quality used the frozen EP-v2 source;
+the final API used EP-v4 with typing/docstrings and stricter attention guards.
+Runtime ASTs match across all four K3 numerical modules after excluding
+configuration validation and typing/docstrings. The new attention rejection
+probe failed on EP-v3 and passed on EP-v4. A fresh native build and
+eight-GPU checkpoint CI remain unverified. Weight reload is unsupported;
+construct a new model instead.
+
+The TP results below are separate measurements and cannot be claimed for V2.
+
+## TP validation scope
+
+A matched graph + DSpark comparison used the real Kimi-K3 checkpoint on eight
+MI355X GPUs. Both arms explicitly selected A8W4; `off` used the native
+`Mxfp4MoEMethod` with no MegaMoE pool. Other model, graph, draft and scheduler
+settings were identical to the supported recipe above.
+
+| Graph + DSpark, A8W4 | GSM8K correct | Truncations | Median seconds |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| Native MoE (`off`) | 1255/1319 | 0 | 1.643770 |
+| MegaMoE (`mega`) | 1261/1319 | 0 | 2.385155 |
+
+Quality used all 1319 GSM8K test examples, the first five train examples as shots,
+greedy sampling, seed 1234, a 512-token output limit and 32-request batches.
+MegaMoE changed accuracy by +0.455 percentage points; paired lost/gained
+counts were 16/22. This is not statistical,
+per-question or logits equivalence. Both arms recorded actual graph replay on
+every TP rank and nonzero DSpark acceptance.
+
+Timing used one workload only: ISL256, OSL64, eight concurrent requests, one
+warmup and three trials. These are offline end-to-end generation medians, not
+online latency distributions. MegaMoE took 45.1% longer
+(0.689x speedup), so this configuration has a performance
+regression. Three trials do not establish statistical stability. Temporary
+large-prefill packing is extra work, but this run did not isolate its contribution.
+
+The restored default-worker MegaMoE graph + DSpark API also passed real
+completions, nonzero draft-acceptance deltas and token/context boundary checks:
+4095 input tokens plus one output succeeded; 4097 inputs were rejected.
+
+Earlier eager custom-split/Mega teacher-prefill checks retained unequal logprobs (maximum absolute
+difference 0.3423 on 128 target tokens), and independent latent diagnostics
+retained unexplained differences (maximum first-call relative L2 0.0197).
+The experiment reused image-native libraries with a Python source overlay;
+a fresh native build and checkpoint CI coverage remain unverified.
+These results do not establish deployment readiness or other workloads.
+Weight reload is unsupported; construct a new model instead.

+def pack_split_weights(w1, s1, w2, s2):
+    """Pack canonical raw MXFP4 bytes for the FP8 split kernels' GUGU layout."""
+    from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_scale, shuffle_weight
+
+    e, _, half_h = w1.shape
+    i = w2.shape[-1] * 2
+    fp4, e8m0 = torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2, torch.float8_e8m0fnu
+    return K3TPWeights(
+        shuffle_weight(w1.view(fp4), is_guinterleave=True, gate_up=True),
+        shuffle_scale(
+            s1.view(-1, half_h // 16).view(e8m0),
+            experts_cnt=e,
+            is_guinterleave=True,
+            gate_up=True,
+        ),
+        shuffle_weight(w2.view(fp4), is_guinterleave=True, gate_up=False),
+        shuffle_scale(
+            s2.view(-1, i // 32).view(e8m0),
+            experts_cnt=e,
+            is_guinterleave=True,
+            gate_up=False,
+        ),
+    )

+def unpack_tp_weights(weights):
+    """Recover canonical bytes from TP's standard 16x16 and E8M0 packing."""
+
+    def weight(t):
+        e, n, k = t.shape
+        return (
+            t.view(torch.uint8)
+            .view(e, n // 16, k // 32, 2, 16, 16)
+            .permute(0, 1, 4, 2, 3, 5)
+            .contiguous()
+            .view(e, n, k)
+        )
+
+    def scale(t, rows, cols):
+        sm, sn = (rows + 255) // 256 * 256, (cols + 7) // 8 * 8
+        return (
+            t.view(torch.uint8)
+            .view(sm // 32, sn // 8, 4, 16, 2, 2)
+            .permute(0, 5, 3, 1, 4, 2)
+            .contiguous()
+            .view(sm, sn)[:rows, :cols]
+            .contiguous()
+        )
+
+    e, n, h2 = weights.w1.shape
+    i2 = weights.w2.shape[-1]
+    return (
+        weight(weights.w1),
+        scale(weights.w1_scale, e * n, h2 // 16),
+        weight(weights.w2),
+        scale(weights.w2_scale, e * h2 * 2, i2 // 16),
+    )

+def split_a8w4(weights, x, topk_weights, topk_ids):
+    """Split A8W4; TP fallback repacks temporarily, split mode stores GUGU once."""
+    import aiter
+    from aiter import dtypes
+    from aiter.fused_moe import fused_moe
+
+    if x.shape[0] == 0:
+        return x.clone()
+    if not getattr(weights.w1, "gate_up_interleave", False):
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError("TP-to-split repacking must run outside graph capture")
+        weights = pack_split_weights(*unpack_tp_weights(weights))
+    result = fused_moe(
+        x.contiguous(),
+        weights.w1,
+        weights.w2,
+        topk_weights.float().contiguous(),
+        topk_ids.int().contiguous(),
+        activation=aiter.ActivationType.Situv2,
+        quant_type=aiter.QuantType.per_1x32,
+        w1_scale=weights.w1_scale,
+        w2_scale=weights.w2_scale,
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        beta=4.0,
+        linear_beta=25.0,
+        gate_mode="interleave",
+        quant_dtype_a=dtypes.fp8,
+        quant_dtype_a2=dtypes.fp8,
+    )
+    return tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(result)

+"""Experimental K3 A8W4 TP runtime adapter.
+
+Callers must serialize all GPU work around the persistent kernel, supply identical
+inputs/routing on every TP rank, and prepare before graph capture. One pool belongs
+to one TP group and model lifetime; layers share it, but own their packed weights.
+The fallback must implement the same A8W4 routed MoE with an already reduced output.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, cast
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class K3TPShape:
+    world_size: int = 8
+    model_dim: int = 3584
+    inter_dim: int = 3072
+    experts: int = 896
+    topk: int = 16
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if (
+            self.world_size,
+            self.model_dim,
+            self.inter_dim,
+            self.experts,
+            self.topk,
+        ) != (8, 3584, 3072, 896, 16):
+            raise ValueError("This experimental adapter only supports K3 TP8")
+
+    @property
+    def local_inter_dim(self) -> int:
+        return self.inter_dim // self.world_size
+
+    def padded_tokens(self, tokens: int) -> int | None:
+        """AR mode requires M divisible by TP; FP8 supports global M <= 256."""
+        if tokens < 0:
+            raise ValueError("tokens must be nonnegative")
+        if tokens > 256:
+            return None
+        return (tokens + self.world_size - 1) // self.world_size * self.world_size
+
+    @property
+    def raw_weight_shapes(self) -> tuple[tuple[int, int, int], ...]:
+        e, h, i = self.experts, self.model_dim, self.local_inter_dim
+        return (
+            (e, 2 * i, h // 2),
+            (e, 2 * i, h // 32),
+            (e, h, i // 2),
+            (e, h, i // 32),
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class K3TPWeights:
+    w1: torch.Tensor
+    w1_scale: torch.Tensor
+    w2: torch.Tensor
+    w2_scale: torch.Tensor
+
+    def as_kwargs(self) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        return {
+            "w1": self.w1,
+            "w1_scale": self.w1_scale,
+            "w2": self.w2,
+            "w2_scale": self.w2_scale,
+        }
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_checkpoint(
+        cls,
+        w13: torch.Tensor,
+        w13_scale: torch.Tensor,
+        w2: torch.Tensor,
+        w2_scale: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        gate_up_layout: str,
+        shape: K3TPShape | None = None,
+    ) -> "K3TPWeights":
+        """Convert raw TP-local checkpoint bytes, before any vLLM shuffle.
+
+        W13 must contain separated [gate, up] rows, not interleaved rows or
+        already shuffled AITER backend parameters. No dequantization is used.
+        The caller owns the original tensors and their replacement lifecycle.
+        """
+        shape = shape or K3TPShape()
+        if gate_up_layout != "separated":
+            raise ValueError("MegaMoE TP needs raw separated gate/up checkpoint rows")
+        tensors = (w13, w13_scale, w2, w2_scale)
+        if any(getattr(tensor, "is_shuffled", False) for tensor in tensors):
+            raise ValueError("cannot convert already shuffled backend weights")
+        for name, tensor, expected in zip(
+            ("w13", "w13_scale", "w2", "w2_scale"),
+            tensors,
+            shape.raw_weight_shapes,
+        ):
+            if tensor.dtype != torch.uint8 or tuple(tensor.shape) != expected:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name}: expected raw uint8 {expected}")
+            if not tensor.is_contiguous() or tensor.device != w13.device:
+                raise ValueError("weights must be contiguous on the same device")
+        if w13.device.type != "cuda":
+            raise ValueError("weight shuffle requires a ROCm device")
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError("convert weights before capture")
+        from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_weight
+        from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
+
+        fp4 = torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2
+        e8m0 = torch.float8_e8m0fnu
+        return cls(
+            shuffle_weight(w13.view(fp4), layout=(16, 16)),
+            e8m0_shuffle(w13_scale.view(-1, shape.model_dim // 32).view(e8m0)),
+            shuffle_weight(w2.view(fp4), layout=(16, 16)),
+            e8m0_shuffle(w2_scale.view(-1, shape.local_inter_dim // 32).view(e8m0)),
+        )
+
+
+class K3MegaMoETPPool:
+    """Explicitly owned, shared runtime; never creates a runtime during forward.
+
+    Pass vLLM's TP cpu_group for IPC metadata collectives. Every rank must prepare
+    the same capacities in the same order. Prepare one instance before attaching
+    it to any layers. Concurrent requests/streams sharing a pool are unsupported.
+    """
+
+    model_mode: str
+
+    def __init__(self, *, group: Any, shape: K3TPShape | None = None):
+        shape = shape or K3TPShape()
+        if not dist.is_initialized() or dist.get_world_size(group) != shape.world_size:
+            raise ValueError("an initialized eight-rank TP process group is required")
+        self.group = group
+        self.rank = dist.get_rank(group)
+        self.shape = shape
+        self._runtime: Any = None
+        self._prepared: frozenset[int] = frozenset()
+
+    def prepare(self, weights: K3TPWeights, tokens: Iterable[int]) -> None:
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError("prepare must run before capture")
+        capacities = {self.shape.padded_tokens(m) for m in tokens}
+        if None in capacities or 0 in capacities or not capacities:
+            raise ValueError("prepare expects nonempty token counts in [1, 256]")
+        valid_capacities = cast(set[int], capacities)
+        local_tokens = sorted(m // self.shape.world_size for m in valid_capacities)
+        if self._runtime is None:
+            from aiter import ActivationType
+            from aiter.ops.flydsl.mega_moe_tp import MegaMoeTP, MegaMoeTPConfig
+
+            cfg = MegaMoeTPConfig(
+                rank=self.rank,
+                world_size=self.shape.world_size,
+                model_dim=self.shape.model_dim,
+                inter_dim=self.shape.local_inter_dim,
+                experts=self.shape.experts,
+                topk=self.shape.topk,
+                max_local_tokens=256 // self.shape.world_size,
+                activation=ActivationType.Situv2,
+                beta=4.0,
+                linear_beta=25.0,
+                comm_mode="ar",
+                comm_dtype="bf16",
+                ar_gather="bf16",
+                act_dtype="fp8",
+            )
+            self._runtime = MegaMoeTP(
+                cfg, **weights.as_kwargs(), group=self.group, device=weights.w1.device
+            )
+        else:
+            self._runtime.set_weights(**weights.as_kwargs())
+        self._runtime.prepare(local_tokens)
+        self._prepared = self._prepared.union(valid_capacities)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        weights: K3TPWeights,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        fallback: Callable[[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Return owned, already reduced latent rows; no norm or shared expert.
+
+        Fallback is selected by global M only, identically on every rank. Runtime
+        initialization/IPC/watchdog errors propagate, including under capture.
+        Call check_errors outside capture before trusting any benchmark result.
+        """
+        if x.ndim != 2 or x.shape[1] != self.shape.model_dim:
+            raise ValueError("expected K3 latent rows [M, 3584]")
+        expected = (x.shape[0], self.shape.topk)
+        if topk_ids.shape != expected or topk_weights.shape != expected:
+            raise ValueError("routing must have shape [M, 16]")
+        if x.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+            raise ValueError("expected BF16 input before internal FP8 quantization")
+        padded = self.shape.padded_tokens(x.shape[0])
+        if padded is None:
+            return fallback(x, topk_weights, topk_ids)
+        if padded == 0:
+            return x.clone()
+        if self._runtime is None or padded not in self._prepared:
+            raise RuntimeError("prepare this token capacity on every rank first")
+        rows = x.shape[0]
+        if padded != rows:
+            # Zero-weight padding uses valid expert 0 and cannot affect real rows.
+            x = torch.cat((x, x.new_zeros(padded - rows, self.shape.model_dim)))
+            topk_weights = torch.cat(
+                (topk_weights, topk_weights.new_zeros(padded - rows, self.shape.topk))
+            )
+            topk_ids = torch.cat(
+                (topk_ids, topk_ids.new_zeros(padded - rows, self.shape.topk))
+            )
+        self._runtime.set_weights(**weights.as_kwargs())
+        reduced = self._runtime(
+            x.contiguous(),
+            topk_weights.float().contiguous(),
+            topk_ids.to(torch.int32).contiguous(),
+        )
+        # A later layer reuses the runtime's output buffer; never expose its view.
+        return reduced[:rows].clone()
+
+    def check_errors(self) -> None:
+        if self._runtime is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("pool is not prepared")
+        self._runtime.check_errors()
+
+
+def k3_tp_tail_partial(
+    reduced_latent: torch.Tensor,
+    shared_partial: torch.Tensor,
+    up_proj_shard: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    rank: int,
+    world_size: int,
+    norm: Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor] | None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Merge one rank's hidden shard; caller all-reduces this result exactly once.
+
+    MegaMoE AR output is already reduced: do not reduce it again before RMSNorm.
+    Shared output must still be TP partial. Up-projection is BF16, output-row
+    sharded, with no gather. Shared work and this tail must run after MegaMoE on
+    the same stream (or with explicit cross-stream dependencies).
+    """
+    if world_size != 8 or not 0 <= rank < world_size:
+        raise ValueError("expected a K3 TP8 rank")
+    if reduced_latent.ndim != 2 or shared_partial.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("expected matrices")
+    rows, hidden = shared_partial.shape
+    if hidden % world_size or reduced_latent.shape[0] != rows:
+        raise ValueError("shared hidden dimension must be divisible by TP")
+    shard_size = hidden // world_size
+    if up_proj_shard.shape != (shard_size, reduced_latent.shape[1]):
+        raise ValueError("expected output-row sharded up-projection weight")
+    latent = norm(reduced_latent) if norm is not None else reduced_latent
+    output = shared_partial.clone()
+    output.narrow(1, rank * shard_size, shard_size).addmm_(latent, up_proj_shard.t())
+    return output

+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.compressed_tensors.compressed_tensors import (  # noqa: E501

+            max_tok_per_rank,

+            runtime = MegaMoEV2(
+                rank=self.ep_rank,
+                world_size=self.ep_size,
+                model_dim=self.hidden_size,
+                inter_dim=self.intermediate_size,
+                experts=self.num_experts,

+                max_tok_per_rank=max_tok_per_rank,

+                situ_beta=4.0,
+                situ_linear_beta=25.0,
+                stage2_p2p_quant="none",
+            )

+        return runtime
